scope: Five bounded annotation query/decoder closures and their extra-SQL dependencies. Root source evidence; not whole Bridge or transitive database audit.

rows.consumer: Session catalog and demanded annotation workflow
rows.currentClosure: WorktreeAnnotationSQLiteRepository.discoverSessions → databaseWriter.read → loadSessions; ordered by created_at/id. Foreign-living candidates separately restrict repository/worktree/lifecycle/source relationship.
rows.outsideSql: Service availability/recovery admission; current source generation and native placement are not established by this list.
rows.copyLimit: A pure row/decode read inside the named repository closure. Actual service/datastore opening/availability is separate; no exported schema/audience or target query API is selected.

rows.consumer: File/Review annotation projection SQL input and source requirements
rows.currentClosure: fetchProjectionSnapshot performs loadSessions and all demanded loadSessionDetail calls inside one databaseWriter.read closure. Demanded session IDs must be in that worktree list. Detail loads session/threads/messages, and decodeMessage reads each draft.
rows.outsideSql: Service projectionRevision/recoveryState captured before await and checked afterward. Descriptor query additionally resolves source generation, captures actual source refresh/placement requirements, revalidates generation, and reserves query/page/worker authority.
rows.copyLimit: Copied rows could supply selected coherent workflow read input only if all required rows/values and permissions are supplied under a target read contract. SQL alone cannot rebuild current runtime projection/recovery token, actual Git/file placement or native worker/publication authority. This is not permission to export all draft fields.

rows.currentClosure: BridgeProductWorktreeAnnotationMessageEntry derives attention from current domain message, includes draft(activeEditToken,body,revision), saved body/revision and message/session/thread revision/identity fields.
rows.outsideSql: Thread placement/context, sourceGeneration, page snapshot/recovery header, descriptor/query lifetime and native consumer currentness.
rows.copyLimit: Current product projection already includes draft/edit values for its admitted local workflow. That local exposure neither selects distributed audience nor makes edit token alone sufficient authority: runtime ownership registry separately checks token→ownerGeneration.

rows.consumer: Output metadata/finite exact-byte source; effect reconciliation read
rows.currentClosure: inspectOutputAttempt calls databaseWriter.read → loadPreparedOutput; reads attempt, ordered exact membership and event, decodes stored snapshot at format version.
rows.outsideSql: Service read availability; finite output source issues bounded descriptor, consumes it once, rereads/compares immutable attempt and returns bytes/hash. Actual clipboard/file effect owner and user visibility are outside this read.
rows.copyLimit: A whole attempt table includes exact_bytes, snapshot_json, errors and destination_path, not just the selected history summary. Target export/privacy/history/custody must be chosen explicitly. Query/descriptor success does not perform or prove output.

rows.consumer: Annotation output history and canMarkNotHandled presentation
rows.currentClosure: fetchOutputHistory uses one databaseWriter.read query joining attempts/membership/current message, excludes cancelled, groups by attempt, orders newest first, applies limit. can_mark_not_handled depends on succeeded state and current handled matching saved revision.
rows.outsideSql: Service availability and maximum-history-summary bound. A later clearOutputHandled is a separate revision-fenced write, not an effect of reading this boolean.
rows.copyLimit: History is not append-only event replay and canMarkNotHandled is state-dependent, not a grant. All joined rows must come from the selected coherent read/position. Unrelated latest positions or partial joins cannot fabricate a complete summary.

writeCounterexample.meaning: Output finalization is a separate writer transaction; inserts event, sets attempt succeeded/destination, marks matching revisions handled and advances session. Never replay from copy invalidation.

instrumentCorrections: Guessed +Projection.swift/+Messages.swift/+Sessions.swift filenames were absent; bounded rg file inventory located actual repository Loading/CatalogLoading files. No absence-of-feature claim adopted.
Shell glob for annotation projection files had no match; rg --files found WorktreeAnnotationProjection* actual files.
proofLimit: Current named read closures and deciding wrappers/decoders inspected. DatabaseWriter.read observed as source API usage, not new external-library snapshot proof. Datastore preparedLocalRepository internals not retraced. No runtime, copy apply, native effect, schema migration or distributed permission proof.
